main_text.l: Bar David, in libello de tredecim modis, quibus Judæi interpretantur Legem suam, Cantabrigiæ Anno 1597 in forma octava, sermone impresso Latino.
CAPVT III. De Deo, Essentia, Nominibus, & Attributis Dei.

CRedit Synagoga fide perfecta, quod Deus Ter Optimus Maximus, non Essentia tantum, sed Personis etiam sit אחד Unus, Unicusque, בדד Solus, ex fidei Judaicæ articulo secundo, qui in precum libellis, sic brevioribus exhibetur verbis, ut sit tum clarior, tum magis in præsenti semper teneatur memoria: אני מאמין באמונה שלמה שהבורא יתברך שמו הוא יחיד ואין יחידות כמוהו בשום פנים והוא לבדו אלהנו היה הוה ויהיה; Fide perfecta credo, Creatorem, cujus nomen sit benedictum, Unicum esse unitate, quæ nullam omnino similem habeat, illumque solum Deum

page.notes: Hebrew lines are printed in Hebrew letters and are transcribed as best read; the Hebrew passage in the third line is partly illegible at its right end. The first Hebrew word of the article is only partly legible.
